note: P4's stage-1 machinery is implemented and its inputs are frozen; no P4 model has been fitted. This file is the interlock. `nn.p4_stage1` refuses to fit anything while `state` is not exactly "authorised", and flipping it is a commit rather than a flag, so beginning a P4 fit is a reviewable diff with a name and a reason attached to it. The runner requires a second, independent confirmation at the command line as well, so a Make target or a script cannot start a fit on its own. `preregistration_hash` must equal `nn.p4_preregistration.preregistration_hash()` at the moment of the run: an authorisation granted under one design does not carry over to an edited one. Authorising stage 1 is not authorising stage 2 — P4-HOLD is a separate one-shot gate in `nn.p4_holdout`, and nothing here opens it. `preregistration_hash` has been rebound twice, each time to keep this file bound to the active design: by source-protocol amendment A1 (docs/p4_preregistration.md §3.4a), which added open_interest_duplicate_policy to the hashed payload, and by source-protocol amendment A2 (§3.4b), which added funding_archive_inception_policy to it. The state was not_authorised before both amendments and is not_authorised after them: rebinding this file to the active design grants nothing, and no P4 fit has been run under this hash or under either of the two it replaced. Only the active hash is recorded here — the superseded values are historical provenance and live in docs/p4_preregistration.md, which is where the amendments are explained.
